newsitem.title: USA: Tyco Intl unit wins $45 mln in contracts.
newsitem.headline: Tyco Intl unit wins $45 mln in contracts.

text.p: Tyco International Ltd said its Simplex Technologies unit won two contracts totaling $45 million from AT&T Corp's Submarine Systems unit to make undersea fiber optic telecommunications cable for the Pam American and Bermuda-U.S. cable systems.
Tyco did not say how much the contracts would boost its earnings. Tyco officials were not immediately available.

The Pan-Am system, an undersea four-fiber cable spanning from Panama to Chile, is slated to start operating in June of 1998, the company said. The Bermuda-U.S. system is slated to begin operating in October 1997, the company added.
